candidate.intended_delta: After the bounded neutral-boat cap, select at most one fresh Warship build and then eligible Warship moves under hks1.hncap.

manifest.normalization: Removed only legacy top-level tags and episode_timeout_minutes fields rejected by Coworld 0.1.28 validation.

trace_equivalence.interpretation: Each physical slot produced an identical stripped action trace after the images swapped. The original C3 delta was action-inert in this episode.

root_causes.evidence: The exact score, tiles, results hash, and stripped per-slot policy traces followed the fixed names and slots after the images swapped.
root_causes.mechanism: Only slot 0 had a leading K1Z name. Hrafn safety rules protected that slot from the untagged comparison arm while allowing the tagged arm to treat the comparison identity as an outsider.
root_causes.effect: The two orientations were not a fair policy comparison.

root_causes.evidence: C3 had 86 legal Warship-build opportunities in slot zero: 82 were preempted by neutral 35 recovery and four by Defense Posts. Slot one had seven opportunities, all preempted by Defense Posts. At turn 3825, build:Warship:146701 was legal after the cap, but the candidate selected build:Defense Post:141689 with hncap. C3 called selectNavalCapEscape only after ordinary cap recovery and later selectors.
root_causes.effect: Ordinary recovery consumed every reachable cap turn, so hks1 fired zero times and C3 remained action-identical to C2.

verdict.candidate_status: Original C3 implementation closed. The precedence-changing repair is registered as a new C4 arm and must prove hks1 reach under equally K1Z-tagged arm identities before outcome interpretation.

repair.scope_change: Moving cap escape ahead of ordinary cap recovery replaces Defense Post and neutral 35 recovery actions, not only exact-C2 holds. That broadens the original C3 boundary and therefore cannot be treated as a repair-only rerun.
repair.match_builder: Bind K1Z Hrafn to the candidate, K1Z Hrafn comparison to the control, and swap both names with their images across seats.
repair.policy: Run bounded cap escape before ordinary cap recovery after severe defense, finish, counter, and reverse-alliance checks.
red_first_tests: When a Warship and an ordinary defensive build are both legal after the cap, C4 must select the Warship with hks1.hncap.
When a Warship and stalled neutral 35 recovery are both legal after the cap, C4 must select the Warship with hks1.hncap while exact C2 selects hg35.hncap.
repair.next_gate: Build an exact amd64 C4 candidate, run the focused and full suites, then repeat the two orientations under the shared foreground runner.
